intuition_en: 5-hour price momentum: short-term trend continuation signal. Captures faster-moving price drift.

expected_direction_explanation_en: Positive direction: short-term momentum persistence, though more noise-sensitive than longer windows.

known_limitations_en: Short lookback increases noise. May generate false signals in sideways markets. No transaction cost adjustment.
